post0.title: Bienvenida
post0.content: Este es el primer post de la página. Aquí voy a publicar notas sobre econometría, datos y economía costarricense. . Las fórmulas se escriben con LaTeX, por ejemplo $ Delta y_t = alpha beta’ y_{t-1} + varepsilon_t$. . Para escribir un post nuevo: . En Markdown: creá un archivo _posts/AAAA-MM-DD-titulo.md con un encabezado como el de este archivo. | Como notebook: poné un .ipynb en _notebooks/ con el nombre AAAA-MM-DD-titulo.ipynb. Hay una plantilla en _templates/. | .

page1.title: About
page1.content: . I’m an economist graduated from the University of Costa Rica. I’m interested in econometrics, data science, data journalism and finance. . I’m passionate about machine learning and artificial intelligence, especially their impact on the labor market and the economy. I believe understanding these technologies is key to navigating the transformations to come. . I currently work as a research assistant at Doble Check, the University of Costa Rica’s fact-checking project, where I verify public claims and analyze government finances using official data. . Previously, I interned at CINDE in the Research, Monitoring & Evaluation area, and spent an exchange semester at Universidad Carlos III de Madrid, where I earned honors in Machine Learning. . When I’m not coding or crunching data, I enjoy reading about economic history and watching football. I dream of applying my skills to improve Costa Rica’s public policies. . If you’d like to collaborate on a project or just chat, drop me a line. I’m always open to new ideas. .
